notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. This is the drive pivot's gear; the follower's axle (#930-006) is drawn by the same file without the sector. The page opens cut on its axis. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
